logline: Heir to a business empire, a groom discovers his 'wedding of the century' is a cold-hearted sham the moment the doors close, leaving him trapped in a marriage of convenience with a woman who despises him.
title: A Match Made in Hell
nitpicker_report: 1. WHAT THE FUCK? (Logic/Data) - The core premise of a dynastic marriage of convenience is a stable trope. The rapid emotional shift from public adoration to private contempt is the dramatic engine and is logically sound within the genre's high-stakes world. No logical flaws detected. 2. WHY THE FUCK? (Purpose) - The scenes serve to establish the central conflict: the public facade versus the private reality of the marriage. This is the inciting incident for the entire series, not filler. The purpose is clear and justified. 3. ON WHAT GROUNDS? (Contract/Boundaries) - The scenario adheres to the rules of the vertical microdrama genre: high emotional stakes, rapid escalation, and a focus on close-ups and character reactions. The power dynamics are visually established and then immediately inverted. 4. FUCK THAT (Realism/Errors) - The protagonist (Groom) is immediately thrown into a crisis. His 'perfect' world and victory are revealed as a lie, representing a significant failure of his perception. There is no deus ex machina; he is left powerless and isolated at the end of the sequence.
shit_redo_report: Initial Draft Flaw: The cold open for Episode 1, featuring a reporter speaking, risked being static. Correction: Rewrote the action to be an aggressive physical gesture ('Reporter thrusts her microphone toward the camera'), making it an active, in-medias-res opening. Second Draft Flaw: Panel descriptions were at risk of becoming lazy and referencing previous panels. Correction: A rigorous pass was made to enforce the INDEPENDENCE LAW, ensuring every panel's description fully restates character appearance (Groom in black tuxedo and glasses, Bride in white dress and fur wrap), location details, and lighting, even if identical to the previous panel. This prevents AI hallucination. Final Polish: The cliffhanger voiceover was sharpened from a generic statement of fact to a more personal, internal realization ('My life... a lie.') to maximize emotional impact and response pressure for the viewer.

episodes.raw_narrative:
Сцена 1: У входа в особняк (Экстерьер)

Репортер (эмоционально, обращаясь в камеру):
— Пресса уже окрестила это событие «свадьбой века»! А как иначе? Брак наследников двух крупнейших бизнес-империй!

Толпа (скандирует):
— Горько! Горько! Горько!

Действие:
Жених и Невеста стоят на ступенях, нежно глядя друг другу в глаза под дождем из золотого конфетти. Жених притягивает Невесту к себе, и они сливаются в долгом поцелуе.

Пожилой мужчина (улыбается, хлопает в ладоши):
Видно, что он доволен союзом.

Действие:
Жених подхватывает Невесту на руки под одобрительные крики толпы и вносит её в здание. Прежде чем массивные двери за ними закрываются, он оборачивается и бросает в камеру победную улыбку.

Толпа: Горько! Горько! Горько!

scenes.scene_instructions:
INITIAL SPATIAL DISPOSITION:
The Groom and Bride stand on the top step at the main-doors of the mansion, facing the courtyard. The Reporter stands in the courtyard-center, facing them and the camera. The Elderly-Man is positioned to the west of the stairs in his wheelchair. A crowd of guests and photographers fills the courtyard.

SONIC ARC: P1-P8: Loud, celebratory atmosphere with crowd cheers, camera clicks, and reporter's voiceover. P9: Abrupt, total silence as the doors slam shut.

P1 [cold_open | MS | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The Reporter controls the narrative, addressing the audience directly. Her microphone is a symbol of public validation.
  EMOTION: The Reporter's face (late 40s, brown hair, glasses, grey coat) shows professional excitement, her eyes wide as she speaks into the lens.
  STAKE OBJECT: The 'CN NEWS' logo on the microphone, representing the scale of public attention.
  STATE: The scene opens on a media event already at its peak, establishing the high stakes of this public union.
  DIALOGUE SEED: Пресса уже окрестила это «свадьбой века»!

P2 [verbal_hook | WIDE | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The crowd holds power, their chant demanding a specific performance from the couple.
  EMOTION: A sea of anonymous, smiling faces, all looking up expectantly at the mansion steps. Some are holding up phones to record.
  STAKE OBJECT: The grand facade of the mansion, symbolizing the wealth and power at the heart of this union.
  STATE: The public pressure on the couple is crystallized into a single, direct command.
  DIALOGUE SEED: Горько! Горько! Горько!

P3 [CU | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The Groom (late 20s, dark hair, glasses, black tuxedo) takes the lead, his gaze on the Bride is possessive and loving.
  EMOTION: The Groom's face shows genuine adoration. The Bride's face (mid-20s, platinum blonde hair, white dress, fur wrap) reflects it back perfectly, a flawless performance of love.
  STAKE OBJECT: A single golden confetti flake lands on the Bride's hair, a fleeting symbol of this perfect moment.
  STATE: The couple presents a united, loving front, fulfilling the crowd's demand.
  DIALOGUE SEED: — silence —

P4 [emotional_capture | MS | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The couple is the center of the universe. Their kiss is the triumphant image everyone came to see.
  EMOTION: The Groom pulls the Bride (mid-20s, platinum blonde, white dress) close for a passionate kiss. Golden confetti rains down around them, catching the bright daylight.
  STAKE OBJECT: The shower of golden confetti, visually representing the immense wealth and celebration surrounding them.
  STATE: The public performance reaches its emotional climax, a seemingly perfect union is sealed.
  DIALOGUE SEED: — silence —

P5 [CU | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The Elderly-Man's (late 70s, grey hair, dark coat, in a wheelchair) approval signifies the true power behind the event.
  EMOTION: A close-up on the Elderly-Man's face, showing a gentle, proud smile. His eyes are filled with tears of joy as he claps his frail hands together.
  STAKE OBJECT: The wheelchair, contrasting his physical frailty with his immense influence.
  STATE: The union receives its final, crucial blessing from the family patriarch.
  DIALOGUE SEED: — silence —

P6 [MS | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The Groom demonstrates physical power and ownership, sweeping the Bride off her feet.
  EMOTION: The Groom (late 20s, dark hair, glasses, black tuxedo) laughs triumphantly as he lifts the Bride (mid-20s, platinum blonde, white dress) into his arms. She wraps her arms around his neck, smiling radiantly.
  STAKE OBJECT: The Bride's opulent wedding dress, which flows around them as he lifts her, emphasizing the fairy-tale image.
  STATE: The romantic ideal is fully realized for the public, transitioning towards the private domain.
  DIALOGUE SEED: — silence —

P7 [pivot | ECU | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The Groom's gaze, directed at the camera, asserts his victory to the world.
  EMOTION: Extreme close-up on the Groom's face as he carries the Bride. He turns his head slightly, breaking the fourth wall to give a confident, victorious smile directly into the camera lens. His eyes gleam with triumph behind his glasses.
  STAKE OBJECT: The reflection of the cheering crowd in the Groom's glasses.
  STATE: The Groom's internal belief in his absolute success is externalized.
  DIALOGUE SEED: VO: Everything is perfect now.

P8 [MS | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The mansion itself, its massive doors ready to swallow the couple, represents the dynasty they now serve.
  EMOTION: Shot from the crowd's perspective, watching the Groom (late 20s, dark hair, glasses, black tuxedo) carry his Bride (mid-20s, platinum blonde, white dress) across the threshold into the darkness of the hall beyond the open doors.
  STAKE OBJECT: The dark, imposing doorway, contrasting with the bright celebration outside.
  STATE: The couple leaves the public sphere, crossing the threshold into their new, private life.
  DIALOGUE SEED: — silence —

P9 [tension_peak | ECU | Mansion Exterior]:
  POWER: The closing doors hold all the power, ending the public story and trapping the characters in the private one.
  EMOTION: An extreme close-up on the seam between the two massive, ornate wooden doors as they slam shut with a final, booming thud. The bright daylight is instantly cut off, leaving only a sliver of darkness.
  STAKE OBJECT: The final sliver of light disappearing as the doors meet.
  STATE: The performance is definitively over. The bright, public fairy tale has ended, and an unknown, ominous private reality is about to begin.
  DIALOGUE SEED: VO: And then... the silence.
  EPISODE EXIT STATE:
    Location: Mansion Hall (just inside the doors)
    Character positions: Groom is standing just inside the closed doors, holding the Bride in his arms.
    Active lighting: The scene is plunged into the dim, dramatic interior light of the hall.
    Active props: Wedding-Bouquet, still held by the Bride.
    Next episode opens on: The Groom gently lowering the Bride to the floor inside the silent hall.

episodes.raw_narrative:
Сцена 2: Холл особняка (Интерьер)

Действие:
Как только массивные двери захлопываются, отсекая шум толпы, Жених осторожно опускает Невесту на пол. Атмосфера мгновенно меняется. Улыбка исчезает с лица Невесты, и она тут же отстраняется от него.

Невеста (холодным, безжизненным тоном):
— Шоу окончено.

Действие:
Она поправляет волосы и смотрит на Жениха с явным отвращением. Тот выглядит растерянным и подавленным.

Невеста (резко, с угрозой):
— Не смей ко мне приближаться.

Действие:
Невеста швыряет свадебный букет на пол и стремительно поднимается по лестнице, не оглядываясь. Жених остается стоять один посреди холла, глядя ей вслед.
